paragraph: Granville's timing system registers a neutral composite reading of 50 out of 100 this morning, completely free of any breadth divergence warnings that might otherwise cloud the tape. Macro conditions amplify this underlying caution, anchored by an elevated VIX at 26.80 sitting in a steep backwardation term structure that peaks at 39.4, alongside a front-loaded skew showing +12.6 points of immediate fear and widening high-yield credit spreads at 3.72%. With credit confidence flat and bellwether semis cooling by -0.21%, the system reflects a market caught in a tug-of-war between resilient cyclical breadth and intense fear-driven option pricing. Expect a choppy, defense-skewed session where intraday rallies will likely face heavy selling pressure until the volatility term structure normalizes.
